a: RegistryBrowser's filter field freezes when a caller passes `onFilterChange` without `filter`
FrameView's frame poll lets a stale `get-frame` answer overwrite a newer one
HistoryTable's row click collapses the open step when the clicked step has nothing to expand
b: StateView and FrameView poll `get-state` by bumping the query's version, so a read slower than the poll interval is always discarded and never shown
The scene tree keeps expanded ids of deleted nodes and re-requests their children on every scene change
The coord table drops the canvas rect, so a client point cannot be reconciled with the world point it shows
